verdict.rationale: Bland documents post-call webhooks that automatically notify your server when a call completes, and pathways can execute webhooks at specific conversation points, which together constitute an event-subscription mechanism. However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose webhook subscription system covering multiple event types (e.g., call started, agent updated, error) or a dashboard/API to manage multiple webhook subscriptions. Missing for 10: broader event-type coverage, subscription management API/UI, and independent confirmation of reliability.
